_comment: One line per C API function, keyed by name, shown next to the signature that gen/dump_capi.py reads out of include/*.h. A function with no entry here falls back to its own header comment, and shows as undescribed if it has neither; gen/check.py reports the count so the gap stays visible.

functions.future_throw: Settles a Future from C with a thrown value, the failure counterpart of future_resolve.
functions.sq_addref: Adds a reference to the value an object handle names, so it survives leaving the stack.
functions.sq_addref_refcounted: Adds a reference, assuming the object is of a reference-counted type. sq_addref checks that first.
functions.sq_allocateASTData: Allocates the arena an AST lives in. Release it with sq_releaseASTData.
functions.sq_analyzeast: Runs the static analyzer over an AST and reports its diagnostics.
functions.sq_arrayappend: Pops a value from the stack and pushes it in the back of the array at the position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_arrayinsert: Pops a value from the stack and inserts it in an array at the specified position.
functions.sq_arraypop: Pops a value from the back of the array at the position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_arrayremove: Removes an item from an array.
functions.sq_arrayresize: Resizes the array at the position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_bindenv: Pops an object from the stack (must be a table, instance, or class); clones the closure at position idx in the stack and sets the popped object as environment of the cloned closure. Then pushes the new cloned closure on top of the stack.
functions.sq_call: Calls a closure. Pops the arguments and the closure's this, and pushes the return value when retval asks for it. A VM suspended mid-call keeps both on the stack instead.
functions.sq_canaccessfromthisthread: Reports whether the calling OS thread is allowed to touch this VM.
functions.sq_checkcompilationoption: Reports whether a compilation option is on.
functions.sq_checkglobalnames: Reports uses of global names that no compilation unit defines.
functions.sq_checktrailingspaces: Makes the compiler report trailing whitespace as a diagnostic.
functions.sq_clear: Clears all the elements of the table/array at position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_clone: Pushes a clone of the table, array, or class instance at the position idx.
functions.sq_close: Releases a Quirrel VM and all related friend VMs.
functions.sq_cmp: Compares the two values on top of the stack. The right operand is pushed first.
functions.sq_cmpraw: Compares the two values on top of the stack without consulting a _cmp metamethod.
functions.sq_collectgarbage: Runs the mark and sweep pass and returns how many reference cycles it freed. Nothing calls it on its own.
functions.sq_compile: Compiles a source buffer and pushes the result as a closure. Nothing runs until that closure is called.
functions.sq_createinstance: Creates an instance of the class at 'idx' position in the stack. The new class instance is pushed on top of the stack.
functions.sq_deleteslot: Pops a key and removes that slot from the table at idx. Does nothing when the slot is absent.
functions.sq_dumpast: Writes a parsed AST as an indented text tree.
functions.sq_dumpastjson: Writes a parsed AST as one line of JSON for a tool.
functions.sq_dumpbytecode: Writes the bytecode of a compiled closure in readable form.
functions.sq_enablesyntaxwarnings: Turns the syntax-level warnings on or off.
functions.sq_enablevartrace: Turns on recording of where a container field was last written, for debugging.
functions.sq_ext_get_array_float: Reads one float element of an array held as an object handle.
functions.sq_ext_get_array_floats: Copies a run of floats out of an array held as an object handle.
functions.sq_ext_get_array_int: Reads one integer element of an array held as an object handle.
functions.sq_ext_getfuncinfo: Fills a function info struct from an object handle, without touching the stack.
functions.sq_fast_equal_by_value_deep: Compares two values by content rather than by identity, following containers.
functions.sq_forbidglobalconstrewrite: Makes redefining an existing global constant an error.
functions.sq_free: Frees a block allocated through the VM's allocator.
functions.sq_freeimports: Frees the import list returned by sq_getimports.
functions.sq_freeze: Pushes an immutable reference to the value at idx. The original is left alone.
functions.sq_freeze_inplace: Makes the value at idx itself immutable.
functions.sq_get: Pops a key and reads that slot of the value at idx, pushing the result. Consults a _get metamethod.
functions.sq_getallocctx: Returns the allocation context the VM was created with.
functions.sq_getbase: Pushes the base class of the 'class' at stored position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_getbool: Gets the value of the bool at the idx position in the stack.
functions.sq_getbyhandle: Pushes the value of a class or instance member using a member handle (see sq_getmemberhandle).
functions.sq_getcallee: Pushes onto the stack the currently running closure.
functions.sq_getclass: Pushes the class of the 'class instance' at stored position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_getclosureinfo: Retrieves number of parameters and number of freevariables from a Quirrel closure.
functions.sq_getclosurename: Pushes the name of the closure at position idx in the stack. Note that the name can be a string or null if the closure is anonymous or a native closure with no name assigned to it.
functions.sq_getcompilererrorhandler: Gets the current compiler error handler function.
functions.sq_getdelegate: Pushes the current delegate of the object at the position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_geterrorfunc: Returns the current error function of the given Virtual machine. (see sq_setprintfunc()).
functions.sq_geterrorhandler: Returns a handle to the VM's current error handler.
functions.sq_getfloat: Gets the value of the float at the idx position in the stack.
functions.sq_getforeignptr: Returns the foreign pointer of a VM instance.
functions.sq_getfreevariable: Gets the value of the free variable of the closure at the position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_getfunctioninfo: Fills a function info struct for the closure at position idx.
functions.sq_gethash: Returns the hash key of a value at the idx position in the stack.
functions.sq_getimports: Returns the list of modules a compiled unit imports.
functions.sq_getinstanceup: Gets the userpointer of the class instance at position idx in the stack. if the parameter 'typetag' is different than 0, the function checks that the class or a base class of the instance is tagged with the specified tag; if not the function fails. If 'typetag' is 0 the function will ignore the tag check.
functions.sq_getinteger: Gets the value of the integer at the idx position in the stack.
functions.sq_getlasterror: Pushes the last error in the stack.
functions.sq_getlocal: Returns the name of a local in a given frame and pushes its value. Free variables are reported first, as though they sat below the real locals.
functions.sq_getmemberhandle: Pops a value from the stack and uses it as index to fetch the handle of a class member. The handle can be later used to set or get the member value using sq_getbyhandle(), sq_setbyhandle().
functions.sq_getobjtypetag: Gets the typetag of a raw object reference(userdata or class).
functions.sq_getprintfunc: Returns the current print function of the given Virtual machine. (see sq_setprintfunc()).
functions.sq_getrefcount: Returns the number of references of a given object.
functions.sq_getregistrytableobj: Returns a handle to the registry table without going through the stack.
functions.sq_getreleasehook: Gets the release hook of the userdata, class instance or class at position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_getscratchpad: Returns a pointer to a memory buffer that is at least as big as minsize.
functions.sq_getsharedforeignptr: Returns the shared foreign pointer of a group of friend VMs.
functions.sq_getsharedreleasehook: Returns the shared release hook of a group of friend VMs.
functions.sq_getsize: Returns the element count of the value at idx. For a class or instance this is the size of its userdata buffer, not a member count.
functions.sq_getstackobj: Takes a handle to the value at position idx, which can then outlive the stack slot.
functions.sq_getstring: Gets a pointer to the string at the idx position in the stack.
functions.sq_getstringandsize: Gets a pointer to the string at the idx position in the stack; additionally retrieves its size.
functions.sq_getthread: Gets a pointer to the thread at the idx position in the stack.
functions.sq_gettop: Returns the index of the top of the stack, which is also the number of values on it.
functions.sq_gettype: Returns the type of the value at the position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_gettypetag: Gets the typetag of the object (userdata or class) at position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_getuserdata: Gets a pointer to the value of the userdata at the idx position in the stack.
functions.sq_getuserpointer: Gets the value of the userpointer at the idx position in the stack.
functions.sq_getvmrefcount: Returns the reference count of a VM.
functions.sq_getvmreleasehook: Returns the release hook of a VM instance.
functions.sq_getvmstate: Returns the execution state of a virtual machine.
functions.sq_getweakrefval: Pushes the object pointed by the weak reference at position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_instanceof: Determines if an object is an instance of a certain class. Expects an instance and a class in the stack.
functions.sq_is_pure_function: Reports whether a closure is marked pure.
functions.sq_isvartracesupported: Reports whether this build was compiled with variable tracing.
functions.sq_kick_watchdog: Restarts the watchdog's clock, for a native that is legitimately slow.
functions.sq_limitthreadaccess: Binds the VM to the calling OS thread, so a stray access from another one is caught.
functions.sq_lineinfo_in_expressions: Makes the compiler emit line information inside expressions, for finer error positions.
functions.sq_loadanalyzerconfig: Loads analyzer settings from a file.
functions.sq_loadanalyzerconfigblk: Loads analyzer settings from an already parsed key-value file.
functions.sq_mark_pure_inplace: Marks a closure pure, which lets the compiler fold calls to it.
functions.sq_mergeglobalnames: Adds a bindings object's names to the set sq_checkglobalnames accepts.
functions.sq_move: Pushes the object at the position 'idx' of the source VM stack in the destination VM stack.
functions.sq_new_closure_slot_from_decl_string: Creates a native closure from a readable declaration string and stores it as a slot, which is how a binding gets real parameter names and types.
functions.sq_newarray: Creates a new array and pushes it in the stack.
functions.sq_newclass: Creates a new class object. If the parameter 'hasbase' is different than 0, the function pops a class from the stack and inherits the new created class from it. The new class is pushed in the stack.
functions.sq_newclosure: Creates a native closure from a C function, taking n values off the stack as its free variables, and pushes it.
functions.sq_newmember: Pops a key and a value from the stack and performs a new slot operation on the class that is at position idx in the stack; if the slot does not exist, it will be created.
functions.sq_newslot: Pops a key and a value and creates that slot on the table or class at idx, as <- does in script.
functions.sq_newtable: Creates a new table and pushes it in the stack.
functions.sq_newtableex: Creates a new table and pushes it in the stack. This function allows you to specify the initial capacity of the table to prevent unnecessary rehashing when the number of slots required is known at creation-time.
functions.sq_newthread: Creates a friend VM that shares the given VM's globals and registry, and pushes it as a thread object. This is what a script thread is.
functions.sq_newuserdata: Creates a new userdata and pushes it in the stack.
functions.sq_next: Advances an iteration. Push a null to start; each call replaces it with an iterator and pushes the key and value. Pop those two before the next call, leave the iterator. Fails when the container is exhausted.
functions.sq_notifyallexceptions: Enable/disable the error callback notification of handled exceptions.
functions.sq_obj_cmp: Orders two objects, as the relational operators do.
functions.sq_obj_get: Reads a slot from an object handle without using the stack.
functions.sq_obj_getinstanceup: Returns the user pointer of an instance held as an object handle.
functions.sq_obj_getsize: Returns the element count of a container held as an object handle.
functions.sq_obj_getuserdata: Returns the payload pointer of a userdata held as an object handle.
functions.sq_obj_is_equal: Compares two objects for equality, as == does.
functions.sq_obj_is_true: Reports whether an object is true by the language's rules.
functions.sq_obj_newslot: Creates a slot on an object handle without using the stack.
functions.sq_obj_set: Writes a slot of an object handle without using the stack.
functions.sq_objtobool: Returns the bool value of a raw object reference.
functions.sq_objtofloat: Returns the float value of a raw object reference.
functions.sq_objtointeger: Returns the integer value of a raw object reference.
functions.sq_objtostring: Returns the string value of a raw object reference.
functions.sq_objtouserpointer: Returns the userpointer value of a raw object reference.
functions.sq_objtypestr: Returns the type name of an object as a string.
functions.sq_open: Creates a VM with its own execution stack, globals and registry.
functions.sq_parsetoast: Parses source into an AST without generating bytecode.
functions.sq_pop: Pops n elements from the stack.
functions.sq_printwarningslist: Writes every diagnostic the analyzer knows, as --warnings-list does.
functions.sq_push: Pushes in the stack the value at the index idx.
functions.sq_pushbool: Pushes a bool into the stack.
functions.sq_pushconsttable: Pushes the current const table in the stack.
functions.sq_pushfloat: Pushes a float into the stack.
functions.sq_pushinteger: Pushes an integer into the stack.
functions.sq_pushnull: Pushes a null value into the stack.
functions.sq_pushobj: Pushes an object handle onto the stack.
functions.sq_pushobject: Pushes the value an object handle names back onto the stack.
functions.sq_pushregistrytable: Pushes the registry table in the stack.
functions.sq_pushroottable: Pushes the current root table in the stack.
functions.sq_pushstring: Pushes a string in the stack.
functions.sq_pushthread: Pushes a thread (a VM handle) onto the stack of another VM.
functions.sq_pushuserpointer: Pushes a userpointer into the stack.
functions.sq_rawdeleteslot: Deletes a slot from a table without employing the _delslot metamethod. Pops a key from the stack and delete the slot indexed by it from the table at position idx in the stack; if the slot does not exist nothing happens.
functions.sq_rawget: Pops a key from the stack and performs a get operation on the object at position idx in the stack, without employing delegation or metamethods.
functions.sq_rawset: Pops a key and a value from the stack and performs a set operation on the object at position idx in the stack, without employing delegation or metamethods.
functions.sq_realloc: Resizes a block allocated through the VM's allocator.
functions.sq_registerbaselib: Registers the base library into the VM's root table.
functions.sq_registernativefield: Exposes a field of a C++ struct held in inline userdata as a slot on the class.
functions.sq_registertypeslib: Registers the built-in type classes, which is what gives every value its methods.
functions.sq_release: Removes a reference added with sq_addref.
functions.sq_releaseASTData: Frees an AST arena and everything allocated from it.
functions.sq_release_refcounted: Removes a reference, assuming the object is of a reference-counted type.
functions.sq_remove: Removes an element from an arbitrary position in the stack.
functions.sq_reservestack: Ensure that the stack space left is at least of a specified size.If the stack is smaller it will automatically grow. If there's a metamethod currently running the function will fail and the stack will not be resized, this situation has to be considered a "stack overflow".
functions.sq_resetanalyzerconfig: Returns every diagnostic to its default state.
functions.sq_reseterror: Reset the last error in the virtual machine to null.
functions.sq_resetobject: Initializes an object handle. Required before the handle is used for anything else.
functions.sq_resume: Resumes the generator at the top position of the stack.
functions.sq_resurrectunreachable: Runs the garbage collector and pushes an array in the stack containing all unreachable object found. If no unreachable object is found, null is pushed instead. This function is meant to help debug reference cycles.
functions.sq_set: Pops a key and a value and writes that slot of the value at idx. Consults a _set metamethod.
functions.sq_set_compile_line_hook: Sets a callback the compiler calls per source line, for coverage tools.
functions.sq_set_table_iter_seed: Sets the seed that randomizes table iteration order, which keeps scripts from depending on it.
functions.sq_set_thread_id_function: Tells the VM how to obtain the current OS thread id, which the thread access checks need.
functions.sq_set_watchdog_hook: Installs the callback the VM asks whether the running script may continue. Returns the previous one.
functions.sq_set_watchdog_timeout_msec: Sets how long a script may run before the watchdog stops it.
functions.sq_setbyhandle: Pops a value from the stack and sets it to a class or instance member using a member handle (see sq_getmemberhandle).
functions.sq_setclassudsize: Sets the user data size of a class. If a class 'user data size' is greater than 0. When an instance of the class is created additional space will be reserved at the end of the memory chunk where the instance is stored. The userpointer of the instance will also be automatically set to this memory area. This allows you to minimize allocations in applications that have to carry data along with the class instance.
functions.sq_setcompilationoption: Turns one compilation option on or off for this VM.
functions.sq_setcompilerdiaghandler: Sets the compiler diagnostic callback function.
functions.sq_setcompilererrorhandler: Sets the compiler error handler function.
functions.sq_setconsttable: Pops a table from the stack and set it as const table.
functions.sq_setdebughook: Pops a closure from the stack and sets it as the debug hook, replacing any hook already set, native or not. A null disables it.
functions.sq_setdelegate: Pops a table from the stack and sets it as the delegate of the object at the position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_setdiagnosticstatebyid: Turns one diagnostic on or off by number.
functions.sq_setdiagnosticstatebyname: Turns one diagnostic on or off by name.
functions.sq_seterrorhandler: Pops a closure or native closure from the stack and sets it as the runtime error handler.
functions.sq_setforeignptr: Sets the foreign pointer of a certain VM instance. The foreign pointer is an arbitrary user defined pointer associated to a VM (by default is value id 0). This pointer is ignored by the VM.
functions.sq_setfreevariable: Pops a value from the stack and sets it as a free variable of the closure at the position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_setinstanceup: Sets the userpointer of the class instance at position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_setnativeclosuredocstring: Attaches a documentation string to a native closure.
functions.sq_setnativeclosurename: Sets the name of the native closure at the position idx in the stack. The name of a native closure is purely for debug purposes. The name is retrieved through the function sq_stackinfos() while the closure is in the call stack.
functions.sq_setnativedebughook: Sets the native debug hook. When a native hook is set it overrides any previously set native or non native hooks. if the hook is NULL the debug hook will be disabled.
functions.sq_setobjectdocstring: Attaches a documentation string to an object.
functions.sq_setparamscheck: Sets the parameter validation scheme for the native closure at the top position in the stack. Allows you to validate the number of parameters accepted by the function and optionally their types. If the function call does not comply with the parameter schema set by sq_setparamscheck, an exception is thrown.
functions.sq_setprintfunc: Sets the print function of the virtual machine. This function is used by the built-in function 'print()' to output text.
functions.sq_setreleasehook: Sets the release hook of the userdata, class instance, or class at position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_setroottable: Pops a table from the stack and set it as root table.
functions.sq_setsharedforeignptr: Sets the shared foreign pointer. The foreign pointer is an arbitrary user defined pointer associated to a group of friend VMs (by default is value id 0). After a "main" VM is created using sq_open() all friend VMs created with sq_newthread share the same shared pointer.
functions.sq_setsharedreleasehook: Sets the release hook of a certain VM group. The release hook is invoked when the last VM of the group VM is destroyed (usually when sq_close() is invoked). The userpointer passed to the function is the shared foreignpointer(see sq_getsharedforeignptr()). After a "main" VM is created using sq_open() all friend VMs created with sq_newthread() share the same shared release hook.
functions.sq_settop: Forces the stack to a given size, padding with nulls when it grows.
functions.sq_settypetag: Sets the typetag of the object (userdata or class) at position idx in the stack.
functions.sq_setvmreleasehook: Sets the release hook of a certain VM instance. The release hook is invoked when the VM is destroyed. The userpointer passed to the function is the VM foreignpointer (see sq_setforeignpointer()).
functions.sq_stackinfos: Retrieve the calls stack informations of a ceratain level in the calls stack.
functions.sq_suspendvm: Suspends the execution of the specified VM.
functions.sq_tailcall: Calls a closure and removes the caller function from the call stack. This function must be invoke from a native closure and he return value of sq_tailcall must be returned by the caller function(see example).
functions.sq_throwerror: Sets the last error in the virtual machine and returns the value that has to be returned by a native closure in order to trigger an exception in the virtual machine.
functions.sq_throwobject: Pops a value from the stack sets it as the last error in the virtual machine. Returns the value that has to be returned by a native closure in order to trigger an exception in the virtual machine (aka SQ_ERROR).
functions.sq_throwparamtypeerror: Throws the VM's own wrong-parameter-type error, so a native reports a bad argument the way the VM does.
functions.sq_tobool: Gets the value at position idx in the stack as bool.
functions.sq_tostring: Converts the object at position idx in the stack to string and pushes the resulting string in the stack.
functions.sq_tracevar: Records the current write to a container field, for the variable trace.
functions.sq_translateasttobytecode: Generates a closure from an AST already parsed and analyzed.
functions.sq_typeof: Pushes the type name of the value at the position idx in the stack. It also invokes the _typeof metamethod for tables and class instances that implement it; in that case the pushed object could be something other than a string (is up to the _typeof implementation).
functions.sq_wakeupvm: Wake up the execution a previously suspended virtual machine.
functions.sq_weakref: Pushes a weak reference to the object at position idx in the stack.
functions.sqstd_aux_error_to_string: Renders the value of a thrown error as a string.
functions.sqstd_createblob: Creates a blob of the given size and pushes it.
functions.sqstd_createfile: Pushes a script file object wrapping an open stream handle.
functions.sqstd_feof: Reports whether a stream handle is at its end.
functions.sqstd_fopen: Opens a file and returns a stream handle.
functions.sqstd_format: Formats values from the stack with a printf-style pattern.
functions.sqstd_formatcallstackstring: Pushes the current call stack rendered as a string.
functions.sqstd_fread: Reads bytes from a stream handle.
functions.sqstd_fseek: Moves the cursor of a stream handle.
functions.sqstd_ftell: Returns the cursor position of a stream handle.
functions.sqstd_fwrite: Writes bytes to a stream handle.
functions.sqstd_getblob: Returns the payload pointer of the blob at idx.
functions.sqstd_getblobsize: Returns the size of the blob at idx.
functions.sqstd_getfile: Returns the stream handle behind the file object at idx.
functions.sqstd_init_streamclass: Creates the stream class that blob and file both take their methods from.
functions.sqstd_printcallstack: Prints the current call stack through the VM's print function.
functions.sqstd_pushstringf: Pushes a string built with printf-style formatting.
functions.sqstd_register_bloblib: Registers the blob library into the VM.
functions.sqstd_register_command_line_args: Publishes the process command line to script as a global.
functions.sqstd_register_datetimelib: Registers the datetime library into the VM.
functions.sqstd_register_debuglib: Registers the debug library into the VM.
functions.sqstd_register_iolib: Registers the io library into the VM.
functions.sqstd_register_mathlib: Registers the math library into the VM.
functions.sqstd_register_stringlib: Registers the string library, including the regular expressions, into the VM.
functions.sqstd_register_systemlib: Registers the system library into the VM.
functions.sqstd_rex_getsubexp: Returns the range one capturing group matched.
functions.sqstd_rex_getsubexpcount: Returns how many capturing groups a compiled expression has.
functions.sqstd_rex_match: Tests whether a whole string matches a compiled expression.
functions.sqstd_rex_matchaborted: Reports whether the last match gave up because it exhausted its backtracking budget.
functions.sqstd_rex_search: Finds the first match of a compiled expression in a string.
functions.sqstd_rex_searchrange: Finds the first match within a range of a string.
functions.sqstd_seterrorhandlers: Installs the standard error and compiler error handlers, which print the message and the call stack.
functions.sqstd_throwerrorf: Throws an error built with printf-style formatting.
